evidence.note: Divergent-Convergent Reasoning generates diverse candidate solutions and then uses reviewer-style reconciliation calls (optionally run recursively with a verifier-free unanimous-consent stopping rule) to recover correct answers even when they start out as a minority, reaching 93.3% on AIME 2024 and 92.0% on AIME 2025 while using about 27% less compute than a fixed single-round baseline.
evidence.title: Divergent-Convergent Reasoning: Scaling Test-Time Compute through Structured Solution Synthesis
